_comment: Power fuels (owner override 2026-10-18). Essence is the science currency, never fuel. energy_per_unit = power_gen * burn_ticks / TICKS_PER_SECOND of the generator (checked by tests/test_logistics2_defs.gd). waste_per_unit feeds the refinery waste path (ledger source power_waste); threat is the running-generator threat value (x threat_idle_mult when out of fuel).

coal.note: dirtiest per energy; infinite coal nodes on the start biome

nitrogen.note: gas vents on outpost biome 'vents'; 3.6x the energy of coal for half the waste per unit

uranium.note: outpost biome 'irradiated' only; huge output, almost no smoke, spent fuel is long-lived waste that must go to a waste dump
